statement: For every prime p, every 1<=h<n, every small C-valued height-h point x of the universal height-n deformation, and every Z_p-basis z_i of ker Theta_x, put r=n-h, P_y(T)=[p]_(H_y)(T), t_i=Theta_x(p^(-1)z_i), and M_ij=(partial P_y/partial u_(h+j-1))(x,t_i). Then the analytic differential D(theta)_x equals M and det(M) is nonzero.
decisive_reduction: If Mv=0, the r constant-coordinate lifts t_i are genuine points of G_v[p]. Frobenius kills the square-zero ideal, so G_v^(p) is constant. Verschiebung annihilates its constant etale p-kernel and descends through the fppf quotient [p] to an etale section. Connected height rigidity makes G_v constant with marking; the full Kodaira-Spencer isomorphism forces v=0.

The dual-dimension formula gives cotangent rank n-1 for the full isomorphism claim. The independent finite-minor proof of the injection needed by the determinant argument avoids this rank count.
Frobenius, Verschiebung, base change and VF=FV=[p] over nonreduced characteristic-p bases.
Connected-etale sequence over the Artin henselian base and splitting over the perfect residue field.
Faithfully flat finite-level quotients and [p] as an fppf sheaf epimorphism, not an arbitrary-point surjection.
Unique constant etale lifts and unique lifted group operations and markings.

They are not admissible formal-group counterexamples and do not establish the theorem's universal quantifiers; the ordinary proof and universal Lean cores carry those respective obligations.
